# 3 bed end of terrace house for sale

> Smith & Butler Estates are delighted to present to the market this beautifully presented and renovated three-bedroom end-of-terrace home, presented in excellent walk-in condition throughout. Finished to an impressive standard from top to bottom, the property has been thoughtfully extended and reconfigured to create a spacious and practical home.
